---
title: backdown forget
nav: forget
description: Remove an indexed drive or folder from the index: its files, folders, scans and what was recognised on it (signed manifests and the chain of custody stay). Nothing on it is touched.
order: 3
---

<!-- Generated by tools/cli-reference.py from `backdown forget --help`. Edit the help in crates/backdown-cli (or the notes in the script) and run it again. -->


```text
backdown forget [OPTIONS] <PATH>
```

## Arguments

`<PATH>`
: The drive or folder as it was indexed (`backdown status` lists them).

Also takes the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.
